title: Only 8% of fund managers report improved investment returns from AI adoption: Morgan Stanley–Oliver Wyman
script:
Only eight percent of fund managers report improved investment returns from AI adoption.
Morgan Stanley and Oliver Wyman published the finding in a new financial services analysis.
Most investment firms struggle to turn automated tools into actual portfolio gains.
Wall Street poured billions into machine learning systems hoping to slash operating costs.
Instead of higher profits, many asset managers face complex data integration hurdles.
Would you trust software with your life savings?
